label: Jetski
authoring: Written by the rig: JetSkiIso.byId('jet_ski').walk(), every number its own (mm), stamped with the rig's LF sha256 and fitted to character rig 10.3 (qa.character) by tools/rig-recipes/hull-walk.mjs. Regenerate with node tools/rig-recipes/hull-walk.mjs --write; never edit by hand.
frame: metres; +x starboard, +y bow, +z up; origin amidships, keel bottom, centreline; polygons counter-clockwise seen from above

walk.rule: A step is legal when the target point is inside an area polygon and outside its holes, and |area z - player z| < stepTol. Ramps interpolate z along their axis (x or y) between a0 and a1, and hold z0 / z1 beyond them. cut = the cutaway key while standing there; cutHi / cutLo replace it above / below zMid (stairs and ladders). Polygons are player-centre: already inset by radius, so the reader never insets them again.

areas.note: the boarding deck, 0.6 m fore and aft and 1.064 m across at the transom: the only surface aboard that takes the walker’s 0.46 m. The centre has 0.077 m fore and aft between the transom edge and the grab handle. It is where she is boarded and where the saddle is mounted from.

interact.label: Handlebars
interact.note: mounted from the boarding deck, over the passenger seat. Astride at anchors.helm, feet in the footwells, hands on the grips (see _excluded saddle_helm)

interact.label: Storage bin
interact.note: under the lid on the cowl’s crown, reached from the forward end of the port footwell

interact.label: Boarding deck
interact.note: off the stern; back aboard from the swim waits on ladderOn (see _excluded reboarding)

cleats.note: the painter and trailer eye on the stem: she lies to it at a wharf
the stern eye on the transom over the pump: the stern line and the tow line

_excluded.reason: a footwell: 0.31 m between the saddle’s pedestal and the liner (0.243 m at its forward end), 1.3 m long. The walker needs 0.46 m clear, so no centre point fits; a well wide enough for the walker would leave no saddle on a 1.20 m beam. It is where the rider’s feet go (anchors.feet), not a place to walk.
the gunwale cap beside the footwell: 0.067-0.067 m of moulding, narrower than the walker. She is boarded over the stern (aft_deck), not over the side.

the cowl: a crowned hood 0.24 m above the rail, falling to the stem. No flat on it and no way onto it past the handlebars; the storage bin under its lid is reached from the footwell (interact hood_bin).

the driver’s seat: astride the saddle, a foot in each footwell, both hands on the grips. 10.3’s only seated clip is drive, whose legs are together and whose hands hold a wheel rim: riding waits on a straddle clip.
the raised seat behind the driver, astride: a seat, not a standing surface. Sitting waits on a sit clip (10.3 has none).
coming back aboard from the water is over the stern onto aft_deck, 0.09 m above the waterline, by the grab handle. No boarding step is drawn.
an open boat 1.20 m across: no side deck to work from; the caps are 0.067-0.067 m of moulding (gunwale_port, gunwale_stbd). Lines are worked from the boarding deck and the saddle.

fitCheck.note: an open boat: no room faces to check

character.method: every frame of each clip for all thirty builds (evalClip + pinsOf), world opts from the walk; hands vs the wheel rim, the lying body vs the berth outline and deckhead, crowns vs headroom, shoulders (2 x collision radius) vs clear widths

fixtures.what: walk every area (1 of them) at the walker’s radius 0.23 m
fixtures.note: each outline is inset by the walker’s radius, the widest 10.3 build’s collision radius or more: every build’s shoulders fit wherever the walker goes. Headroom is the stand fixtures’; steps are the step fixtures’.

fixtures.what: stand in footwell_port between its fittings (the narrowest gap a figure stands in: 0.31 m)
stand in footwell_stbd between its fittings (the narrowest gap a figure stands in: 0.31 m)
come aboard from the water (onto reboarding, 0.09 m above the waterline; no ladder)
fixtures.note: no ladder on this hull: a swimmer cannot climb back aboard (see _excluded reboarding)
10.3 has no sit clip: drive is its only seated clip, and its hands hold a wheel
